🚀 ABOUT OUR TEAM – NASA SPACE APPS CHALLENGE
We are a team of five enthusiastic and passionate students who are excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. As first-year Computer Science Engineering (CSE) students, we are at the beginning of our journey into the world of technology, innovation, and problem-solving. We believe that learning becomes more meaningful when we work together, share ideas, and challenge ourselves to think beyond boundaries.
